notes: Borough's 4th Round obligation is 100 units (prospective need), accepted via binding resolution. A mediation agreement with NJBA dated January 29, 2025 set the obligation at 100 units — lower than DCA's non-binding 106 figure. VLA results in RDP=0 and Unmet Need=100. Borough must address 25% of unmet need (25 units) with realistic zoning. Plan was originally adopted June 2025 and amended February 4, 2026 by Planning Board, endorsed by Council February 9, 2026. Four Round 4 sites address 25% requirement: 95 County Road (2 aff units under construction), 127 Hardenburgh Ave (17-unit 100% affordable, construction fall 2026), Downtown Rehabilitation Area overlay (50% set-aside), 232 County Road (1 affordable unit by right rezoning per Dec 29, 2025 mediation agreement with 232 County Development LLC). Accessory Apartment Program is borough-wide. Rehab obligation is 0.
